title: Menu holder refactor, test expansion, and release artifact improvements
summary: Since de29c7dd, Plugin Engine modernized menu holder flow, added broad Paper test coverage, and ensured Nexus releases publish sources and Javadocs alongside runtime artifacts.
highlights: Changed: revamped chest, hopper, paginated, and base UI holder flow to use dedicated InteractiveMenuHolder implementations and cleaner inventory routing
Changed: removed holder cache usage and updated inventory controller/menu interaction internals for safer menu lifecycle handling
Added: comprehensive Paper-side tests for GUI menus, button behavior, cooldowns, item builder, AABB utilities, and MockBukkit integration scaffolding
Added: dedicated menu holder classes for chest, hopper, and paginated menus to improve separation of concerns in GUI internals
Internal: release publishing now includes source and Javadocs JARs for Nexus publication
Internal: dependency and build updates to support Paper test dependencies and JUnit platform execution
Docs: README dependency examples were refreshed to align with the updated 1.1.2 coordinates
